title: husainov-acyclicity
description: An Alexandrov-topology poset that additionally satisfies Husainov's necessary-and-sufficient acyclicity condition, under which Cech cohomology agrees with derived-functor sheaf cohomology; generated by imposing acyclicity of the poset's Dedekind-MacNeille cuts.

cutAcyclicity.description: every Dedekind-MacNeille cut sub-poset of the underlying poset is cohomologically acyclic (algorithmically computable for finite posets)

cechAgreesWithDerived.description: under this condition Cech cochain computation equals derived-functor sheaf cohomology of the sheafification on the nose, not merely approximately
